caption: Figure 3: System model, SW stack, and I/O path of a multi-tenant ZNS SSD deployment. RD/WR=Read/Write. The write cache flushes data to the NAND flash asynchronously. Zone resets are completed after invalidating the mapping layer, where NAND blocks are erased lazily.
